crossRefs.note: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
You, Yahweh, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.
I cried to you, Yahweh. I made supplication to the Lord:
This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.
Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.
Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
When he was in distress, he begged Yahweh his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.
He prayed to him; and he was entreated by him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his…
Hezekiah prayed to Yahweh, saying,
In those days Hezekiah was sick and near death. Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, came to him, and said to him…
Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.
Return, Yahweh. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.
Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.
The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.
For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are…
Be pleased, Yahweh, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, Yahweh.
Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my…
I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land.
But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his breast, saying, ‘God…
He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”
Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”

translations.web: Then I called on Yahweh’s name: “Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
translations.bsb: Then I called on the name of the LORD: “O LORD, deliver my soul!”
translations.kjv: Then called I upon the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
translations.asv: Then called I upon the name of Jehovah: O Jehovah, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
